notes: This source/test traceability contract covers the bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 Unsubscribe Object Class Attributes service in Umbra's opt-in, non-installable development profile. The official C++ binding exposes the one §5.9 service through a whole-class overload and an attribute-set overload. The registry removes the requested ordinary subscriptions and produces the existing scope/relevance effects. Its focused production-filesystem regression adds the successful-void report boundary for both binding forms: an invalid class appends nothing; the attribute-set overload appends ObjectClassHandle type 36 and supplied AttributeHandleSet type 1; and the whole-class overload appends the same first argument plus a type-34 Null optional-set slot. Both records precede separately queued declaration, scope, and relevance callbacks. The Requirements Lab assigns the §5.9 service-body candidates from its coalesced source page to clause-5.9.4; RL-078 records that ownership mismatch while this contract retains the direct §5.9 source context. Empty-set semantics, complete discovery/reflect delivery matrices, MOM interaction delivery, timestamped behavior, save/restore, DDM, remote transport, catalog evidence, validation, and conformance remain outside this slice.
